s.a.ios_title: Shigar da 24/24 ONE WORLD a kan iPhone
s.a.ios_s1: Buɗe wannan shafi cikin Safari (ko Chrome).
s.a.ios_s2: Danna maɓallin Shawara ⬆ (a ƙasan fuskar kwamfyutan, ko ••• sa'an nan Shawara).
s.a.ios_s3: Scroll ƙasa da kuma danna "Add to Home Screen", sa'an nan kuma "Add".
s.a.ios_s4: Bude 24/24 ONE WORLD daga alamar alama ta sabon, sa'an nan kuma kunna kiran 🔔: za a yi maka gargaɗi har ma lokacin da aka kulle shirin (iOS 16.4 ko na ƙarshe).
s.a.ios_card: 📲 A kan iPhone, ƙara 24/24 ONE WORLD zuwa fuskar kwamfyutan gida don karɓar kiran har ma idan shirin ayuka an kulle shi.
s.a.trust: 🔒 Ba ka da bukatar shiga, ba ka da katin banki: ba za a karɓi kudinka ta atomatik ba. Tarihinka zai kasance ne kawai akan wayarka.
s.a.install_android: A Chrome: menu et → "Ƙara zuwa Home allon" (ko "Install app").
s.a.install_ios: A kan iPhone, a cikin Safari: Share maɓallin ⬆ → "Ƙara zuwa Home Screen".
s.a.install_done: An shigar da 24/24 ONE WORLD a kan wannan na'ura.
s.a.tagline: Ka faɗi harshenka, 24/7. 24/24 ONE WORLD zai yi sauran.

s.a.pay_note_html: An biya kudin a kan shafin Stripe mai aminci, a waje da wannan shirin. Sharuɗɗan sayarwa (da Faransanci).
s.a.footer_note_html: 24/24 ONE WORLD — Asusun da aka tabbatar da imel. Tarihinka da ƙayyadaddun ka'idojinka suna zaune a kan wannan na'ura. QDialogButtonBox · Sharuɗɗan Amfani · QSql (fuskokin doka a Faransanci)

s.a.mic_help_android: 🔓 Domin cire hana mai magana: a cikin Chrome, zaɓi ät → Zaɓuɓɓuka → Zaɓuɓɓukan Shafin → Mai magana → sebastienchevrier.github.io → Yi izinin. Idan wannan bai isa ba: Zaɓuɓɓukan waya → Shiryoyin Ayuka → Chrome → Izini → Mai magana → Yi izinin. Sa'an nan kuma sake buɗe shiri-girma.
s.a.mic_help_ios: 🔓 Domin cire hana mai magana: iPhone Settings → Safari → Microphone → Allow, sa'an nan kuma sake loda shafin.
s.a.mic_help_app: 📲 Aikace-aikacen da aka shigar: buɗe Chrome, je zuwa sebastienchevrier.github.io/24-24-talk, danna alamar a hagu na adireshin → Permissions → Microphone → Allow (ko "Reset permissions"). Sa'an nan kuma kulle kuma sake buɗe shirin.
